headword: {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}

definitions.explanation: A governing body at the regional or municipal level, including prefectures, cities, towns, and villages. Responsible for local administration, public services, and community governance.

examples.japanese: {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧。
{地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支援策|しえんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The local government announced its own support measures.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人口減少|じんこうげんしょう}→人口減少：24385_jinkougenshou⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}している→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧。
examples.english: Many local governments are facing the challenge of population decline.

notes: Compound of ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (local/regional) + ⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧ (self-governing body). Often shortened to ⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧ in conversation and news. In Japan, {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい} includes ⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧ (prefectures) and ⟦{市町村|しちょうそん}→市町村：16065_shichouson⟧ (cities, towns, and villages). Common collocations: {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧ (local government initiatives), {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧ (local government finances).
